title: Funerals with Manuel Perez, carnival parades with Jake Steve's white band
summary: Father played funerals with Manuel Perez and carnival parades with Jake Steve's band (the Maccabees), a white band; he played with all kinds of bands.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Oh yes. Do you remember which bands did he play with Manuel Perez on that or some of the other bands?
The funerals he played with Manuel Perez, but the carnival parades he played with Jake Steve.
Jake Steve's band. I heard of all bands. The Maccabees. They were called the Maccabees.
I never knew, I haven't heard of them.
Well that's him. I'm sure if you would find someone who's connected with Jake Steve.
We probably will run into someone sooner or later.
He'll tell you about Jake Steve. My daddy played a long time with Jake Steve. What did Jake Steve play?
Did he play? Yes, he played an instrument. I can't remember which one.

But he was at, he was, that was the name of the band. He was an electromeda. Yes, at the time he was, in fact he and my daddy, sometimes when he couldn't take over, my daddy would take over. That's how they would alternate.
You remember, was it a colored band or a white band? Because I understand your father played with some white bands.
Jake Steve was a white band.
That's what I thought it might be.
He played, oh my daddy played with all kinds of bands. Just all, anybody that had, was ready to have him, he played. He just didn't stop at anything.
